flip.rules.defaultMessage: Edition 3.1 and publisher FAQ: sum number cards, apply ×2 if present, then +2 to +10 modifiers, then +15 for seven distinct numbers. A bust scores zero. Check victory after all round results: highest score of at least 200. If the leaders tie, everyone continues. Resolve card actions physically; this is a score sheet, not a dealing simulator. For 3 to 16 players on this device.

skull.rules.defaultMessage: Classic 2021, 3 to 8 players, without advanced cards or pirate powers. Bids before results; one trick per card dealt. Exact bid: 20 points per trick plus bonuses. Incorrect bid: −10 per trick off. Zero bid: +10 per card if successful, otherwise −10 per card. Ten rounds; ties trigger additional ten-card rounds (eight cards with eight players) until one winner remains. No two-player Graybeard mode.

cricket.rules.defaultMessage: Three marks close each target from 20 to 15 and bull. Single = one mark, double = two, triple = three (bull: single or double). In standard scoring, extra marks score the target’s value while at least one opponent has not closed it. Closing all targets with a score at least as high as every opponent wins immediately. Without points, the first to close everything wins. Three darts per turn; other sectors and misses score nothing. Order fixed at setup; more than two sides is free play.

darts.rules.defaultMessage: One leg, straight-in from 301 or 501 according to settings. Up to three darts per turn, then the next side. Reach exactly zero. With double-out, finish on a double (50 bull allowed). Going below zero, leaving one point or finishing without a double cancels the entire visit with double-out. With straight-out, only going below zero cancels the visit. A miss scores zero and uses a dart. Side order fixed at setup; more than two sides is free play.

darts.bust.defaultMessage: Bust: visit canceled, score reset to its starting value and next side plays.

darts.invalid.defaultMessage: Invalid action: check the side, sector, achievable total and double-out.

farkle.rules.defaultMessage: Farkle rules: 1 = 100, 5 = 50; three ones = 300, other triples = face × 100. Four of a kind = 1000, five = 2000, six = 3000; straight, three pairs or four of a kind plus a pair = 1500; two triples = 2500. Combinations must come from the same roll. Keeping all six dice lets you roll all six again. A roll with no scoring dice loses the turn. Entry threshold and target are fixed by settings. At the target, each other side gets one final turn; tied highest scores share victory.

farkle.rollHint.defaultMessage: Enter the faces of your physical dice, then tap the scoring dice to keep. Confirm the roll before continuing or banking the turn’s points.

farkle.bust.defaultMessage: No scoring dice: turn points are lost.

sixNimmt.rules.defaultMessage: Play the cards on the table, then enter each player’s bullheads for the round. Lowest total wins. When a player reaches at least 66 points, finish all entries for that round before determining the winner. Players tied for the lowest total share victory. 2 to 10 individual players; resolve rows and dealing physically.

timesUp.rules.defaultMessage: Prepare 40 physical cards, reused across three rounds. Each turn lasts 30 seconds. Round 1: describe freely, no passing. Round 2: one word only, passing allowed. Round 3: act without speaking, passing allowed. Change your team’s clue-giver each turn. Highest total wins; ties share victory.

molkky.confirmHint.defaultMessage: The journal will be recalculated. Correcting or undoing a throw may reopen a finished match.

molkky.rules.defaultMessage: One fallen pin scores its number; multiple fallen pins score their count. Only pins lying fully on the ground count. Reach exactly 50 points; going over 50 drops the total to 25. A miss scores zero. Three consecutive misses eliminate the player or team and reset their score to zero. A successful throw resets the miss count. Teams share a score and miss count. Skip eliminated players or teams; the last remaining side wins. Enter throws in the selected player or team order.

four21.rules.defaultMessage: Charge 21 rules: 421 = 10 tokens, nénette = 2. Load in one roll; unload in up to three rolls, limited by the first player. The loser starts the next turn. At the end of loading, players with no tokens win; otherwise, the first to shed all tokens wins. Break ties with physical dice outside the app.

four21.tie.defaultMessage: Tie: roll physical dice to break it, then enter the two distinct results. Players outside the tie remain fixed.

ruleGuide.yams.upperOn.defaultMessage: Upper bonus enabled: +35 when the first six categories total at least 63.

ruleGuide.yams.extraOn.defaultMessage: Each extra Yams earns +100 after a Yams scored as 50. A scratched Yams earns no bonus. Enter five matching dice or mark Another Yams.

ruleGuide.yams.jokerOn.defaultMessage: Joker enabled: after filling the Yams box, another Yams must use the matching upper box if empty. Otherwise, choose an empty lower box; full house and straights score their fixed values. If all lower boxes are filled, scratch an upper box.

ruleGuide.yams.jokerOff.defaultMessage: Joker disabled: an extra Yams does not substitute for a full house or straight.

ruleGuide.yams.settings.defaultMessage: Fixed four-of-a-kind scoring, custom straights and disabled bonuses are table choices. The table above follows this match’s settings.

ruleGuide.yams.finish.defaultMessage: After 13 boxes per player, the highest total wins. The app awards shared victory for ties.

ruleGuide.farkle.goal.defaultMessage: Build the highest total while aiming for {target} points without losing your turn’s points.

ruleGuide.farkle.roll.defaultMessage: Start with six dice. After each roll, keep at least one scoring group. Each combination must come from that single roll.

ruleGuide.farkle.keep.defaultMessage: Reroll the remaining dice or bank the turn’s points. Once all six dice have scored, you may roll all six again.

ruleGuide.farkle.risk.defaultMessage: A roll with no scoring dice loses all unbanked turn points and passes play. Previously banked points remain safe.

ruleGuide.farkle.special.label.defaultMessage: 1–6 straight, three pairs or four of a kind + a pair

ruleGuide.farkle.entry.defaultMessage: First bank: at least {entry} points in one turn. A threshold of 0 means no opening requirement.

ruleGuide.farkle.settings.defaultMessage: The PlayMonster reference uses 10,000 points and a 500-point opening. The {target} target and threshold above are this match’s settings. The app shares tied victories.

ruleGuide.farkle.finish.defaultMessage: Reaching {target} gives every other player one final turn. The highest final total wins; tied leaders share victory.

ruleGuide.four21.goal.defaultMessage: Get rid of your tokens after the 21-token pot has been distributed.

ruleGuide.four21.charge.defaultMessage: Charge: each player rolls three dice once. The weakest takes the strongest combination’s token value from the pot, capped by the remaining pot.

ruleGuide.four21.discharge.defaultMessage: Discharge: the starter rolls one to three times. Others cannot exceed that count. The strongest gives tokens to the weakest, capped by their own holdings.

ruleGuide.four21.starter.defaultMessage: The weakest starts the next round.

ruleGuide.four21.nenette.value.defaultMessage: The weakest combination; if it loses, transfer 2 tokens, capped by availability.

ruleGuide.four21.ranking.defaultMessage: Ranking: 421, 111, then 116 > 666 > 115 > 555 > 114 > 444 > 113 > 333 > 112 > 222, then straights, ordinary combinations and nénette. Within a group, higher values win.

ruleGuide.four21.house.defaultMessage: This is Charge 21, the app’s local scoring table. 421 is traditional; a publisher’s booklet describes its own edition and does not make this table universal.

ruleGuide.four21.tie.defaultMessage: Break relevant ties with physical dice, then select the strongest and weakest among the eligible players.

ruleGuide.four21.finish.defaultMessage: When the pot empties, players with no tokens win together. Otherwise, the first to empty their holdings during discharge wins.

ruleGuide.x01.turn.defaultMessage: Take turns throwing up to three darts. A miss uses one dart.

ruleGuide.x01.subtract.defaultMessage: Subtract scored points from the remaining total. A valid checkout at 0 ends the leg immediately.

ruleGuide.x01.bull.value.defaultMessage: 25 / 50; the inner bull counts as double 25.

ruleGuide.x01.miss.label.defaultMessage: Miss or dart that does not stay in the board

ruleGuide.x01.doubleOut.defaultMessage: Double-out enabled: the final dart must be a double. Overshooting 0, leaving 1 or reaching 0 without a double cancels the whole visit and passes play.

ruleGuide.x01.straightOut.defaultMessage: Straight-out enabled: reaching exactly 0 is enough. Only overshooting cancels the whole visit. This is a table format.

ruleGuide.x01.entry.defaultMessage: Straight-in: no double is needed to start scoring. A 301 start and more than two sides are table options.

ruleGuide.x01.finish.defaultMessage: The first valid checkout wins the leg.

ruleGuide.cricket.targets.defaultMessage: Targets may be played in any order. Three marks close a target.

ruleGuide.cricket.turn.defaultMessage: Each visit has up to three darts, then play passes to the next side.

ruleGuide.cricket.close.defaultMessage: A target can still score while at least one opponent has not closed it. Once everyone closes it, it scores no more points.

ruleGuide.cricket.bull.value.defaultMessage: 1 / 2 marks; each excess mark is worth 25 points.

ruleGuide.cricket.other.value.defaultMessage: No marks; the dart is used.

ruleGuide.cricket.pointsOn.defaultMessage: Points enabled: marks beyond the third score the target’s value only while an opponent still has it open.

ruleGuide.cricket.pointsOff.defaultMessage: No-score mode: excess marks are ignored. This is a table option distinct from the reference’s scoring Cricket.

ruleGuide.cricket.finishPoints.defaultMessage: To win, close every target and have at least as many points as every opponent. At equal scores, the first complete closure wins.

ruleGuide.cricket.finishNoPoints.defaultMessage: The first side to close every target wins.

ruleGuide.dartsSeries.win.defaultMessage: Match mode: win {count} legs to win the match.

ruleGuide.dartsSeries.sets.defaultMessage: Win {legs} legs to take a set and {sets} sets to win the match. Both sides start each set with zero legs won.

ruleGuide.dartsSeries.alternate.defaultMessage: Leg starts alternate between the two sides from the saved first starter.

ruleGuide.dartsSeries.loser.defaultMessage: The loser of a leg starts the next one. The first leg uses the saved starter.

ruleGuide.dartsSeries.freePlay.defaultMessage: More than two sides is free play, extending the same scoring and victory conditions to every opponent.

ruleGuide.skull.goal.defaultMessage: Predict your tricks exactly and have the highest total after ten rounds.

ruleGuide.skull.deal.defaultMessage: Deal one card per player in round 1, then one more per round, capped at {maxCards} cards with this deck and roster.

ruleGuide.skull.bid.defaultMessage: Everyone bids before play. Confirm all bids, then play the hand with physical cards.

ruleGuide.skull.tricks.defaultMessage: Follow the led suit when possible; special cards may still be played. Black is trump. Pirates beat numbers and mermaids; the Skull King beats pirates, but a mermaid beats the Skull King.

ruleGuide.skull.record.defaultMessage: Enter tricks won and bonus captures. Each trick has one card per player; its winner leads the next trick.

ruleGuide.skull.miss.value.defaultMessage: −10 × the difference between bid and tricks won

ruleGuide.skull.pirate.label.defaultMessage: Pirate captured by the Skull King

ruleGuide.skull.king.label.defaultMessage: Skull King captured by a mermaid

ruleGuide.skull.bonuses.defaultMessage: Bonuses count only when the bid is exactly correct.

ruleGuide.skull.edition.defaultMessage: Classic 2021 scoring without pirate abilities, advanced cards or Rascal. The Tigress acts as a pirate or escape. If everyone escapes, the first wins. If a mermaid, pirate and Skull King share a trick, the mermaid wins.

ruleGuide.skull.finish.defaultMessage: After ten rounds, the highest total wins. If leaders tie, everyone plays another round with the final hand size until the tie breaks.

ruleGuide.flip.goal.defaultMessage: Have the highest total at the end of a round in which someone reaches 200.

ruleGuide.flip.deal.defaultMessage: The dealer gives everyone a face-up card. On your turn, take another card or stop to keep your points.

ruleGuide.flip.choice.defaultMessage: Number cards run from 0 to 12. Modifiers and Action cards do not count toward the seven numbers.

ruleGuide.flip.duplicate.defaultMessage: Receiving a duplicate number busts your hand for 0, unless Second Chance lets you discard the duplicate and that protection.

ruleGuide.flip.seven.defaultMessage: Seven distinct numbers trigger Flip 7: +15 and the round ends immediately for everyone. The 0 counts as a distinct number.

ruleGuide.flip.actions.defaultMessage: Resolve actions with the physical cards: Freeze banks that player’s points; Flip Three deals three cards, stopping on a bust or Flip 7; Second Chance protects against one duplicate.

ruleGuide.flip.finish.defaultMessage: A round ends when everyone stops or busts, or on a Flip 7. At 200 or more, the highest total wins; if leaders tie, everyone plays another round.

ruleGuide.molkky.setup.defaultMessage: Arrange the twelve numbered pins using the rulebook’s layout. Set the playing order before starting.

ruleGuide.molkky.throw.defaultMessage: Throw the baton underhand to knock down pins. Only fully fallen pins count.

ruleGuide.molkky.raise.defaultMessage: Stand pins back up where they fell, then pass play to the next player.

ruleGuide.molkky.several.value.defaultMessage: The number of pins, not their printed values

ruleGuide.molkky.over.defaultMessage: Exceeding 50 immediately resets the score to 25. You must reach 50 exactly to win.

ruleGuide.molkky.elimination.defaultMessage: Three consecutive misses eliminate the player or side. A scoring throw resets the miss counter.

ruleGuide.molkky.team.defaultMessage: In teams, members alternate throws and share their score and misses. The app displays 0 for an eliminated side.

ruleGuide.molkky.finish.defaultMessage: The first side to 50 wins. In this app, the last remaining side also wins if all opponents are eliminated.

ruleGuide.six.goal.defaultMessage: Collect as few bullheads as possible.

ruleGuide.six.deal.defaultMessage: Deal ten cards each. Place four face-up cards to start four rows, each holding at most five cards.

ruleGuide.six.choose.defaultMessage: Everyone chooses a card face down, then reveals together. Place them from lowest to highest.

ruleGuide.six.place.defaultMessage: Place a card after a lower number, choosing the row whose last card is closest to it.

ruleGuide.six.small.defaultMessage: If your card is lower than every row end, take any row and replace it with your card.

ruleGuide.six.sixth.defaultMessage: If your card would be sixth in a row, take its five cards. Your card starts the new row.

ruleGuide.six.five.label.defaultMessage: Multiple of 5, excluding multiples of 10 and 55

ruleGuide.six.record.defaultMessage: After all {cards} cards, count the bullheads in each player’s penalty pile. Enter every player’s result, including an explicit 0 for no penalties.

ruleGuide.six.finish.defaultMessage: If any cumulative score reaches at least 66, finish scoring that round; the lowest total wins. Otherwise, deal ten new cards. The app shares victory among tied leaders.

ruleGuide.timesUp.goal.defaultMessage: Help your team guess the most cards over three rounds.

ruleGuide.timesUp.setup.defaultMessage: Form 2–6 teams with 4–12 players total and at least 2 per team. Prepare {cards} physical cards; reuse the same cards in all three rounds.

ruleGuide.timesUp.timer.defaultMessage: The clue-giver has {seconds} seconds. Set correctly guessed cards aside; the others still need to be guessed.

ruleGuide.timesUp.rotate.defaultMessage: Team members take turns as clue-giver. Once all 40 cards are guessed, shuffle them for the next round.

ruleGuide.timesUp.free.value.defaultMessage: Describe freely; the team may guess repeatedly. Cards cannot be skipped.

ruleGuide.timesUp.word.value.defaultMessage: One word per card and one team guess. Skipping is allowed.

ruleGuide.timesUp.mime.value.defaultMessage: No words. Gestures, sound effects and humming are allowed; one guess per card, skipping allowed.

ruleGuide.timesUp.forbidden.defaultMessage: During description, do not use the word or a derivative, translation, spelling or rhyming clue. Gestures and sound effects are reserved for mime.

ruleGuide.timesUp.answers.defaultMessage: In rounds 2 and 3, only the first answer counts. A skipped or missed card cannot return during that same turn.

ruleGuide.timesUp.timerChoice.defaultMessage: The app starts each turn with a fresh 30 seconds, including at round changes. On expiry, confirm the number of correct cards to pass play.

ruleGuide.timesUp.finish.defaultMessage: After round three, add the correctly guessed cards. The highest total wins; the app awards shared victory for a tie.

ruleGuide.custom.goal.defaultMessage: Play using the custom rules saved with this match.

ruleGuide.custom.entry.defaultMessage: Choose the participant and enter the requested values within the table’s limits.

ruleGuide.custom.saved.defaultMessage: Scores follow this match’s saved rule. Agree together on how to play the physical game.

ruleGuide.custom.shared.defaultMessage: The game ends at its saved target or round count, or by manual finish if allowed. Tied leaders share victory.

ruleGuide.custom.continue.defaultMessage: The game ends at its saved target or round count, or by manual finish if allowed. Continue playing to break tied leaders.

language.system.description: Use the device’s current language, falling back to English when unavailable.

about.intro.defaultMessage: Scoretrackrr helps you keep score for your games, in an installable app that works offline.

about.checkHint.defaultMessage: Checks the latest stable GitHub release only when requested. A connection is required.

about.noRelease.defaultMessage: No stable release has been published on GitHub yet.

about.results.current.defaultMessage: You are using the latest published stable version ({version}).

about.results.ahead.defaultMessage: Your version is newer than the latest published release ({version}).

about.results.unknown.defaultMessage: Latest publication: {version}. Open the release to check its version.

about.errors.offline.defaultMessage: Checking requires a connection. Try again when you are online.

about.errors.rateLimited.defaultMessage: GitHub’s request limit has been reached. Try again later.

about.errors.unavailable.defaultMessage: GitHub releases cannot be checked right now. Check your connection and try again.

about.errors.invalidResponse.defaultMessage: GitHub’s response could not be used to check the version. Open the repository or try again later.

about.errors.timeout.defaultMessage: GitHub is taking too long to respond. Try again shortly.

dartsCork.hint.defaultMessage: The side closest to the center starts the game or the first leg.

dartsCork.instructions.defaultMessage: One player per side throws one dart at the center. Remove a bull (50) or outer bull (25) before the next throw. Select the side closest to the center: this throw scores no points.

dartsCork.tie.defaultMessage: A tie, two bulls or two outer bulls: the sides tied for first throw again in reverse order until a winner is determined.

dartsCork.chooseSides.defaultMessage: Select players or teams before choosing the cork winner.

dartsCork.required.defaultMessage: Choose the cork winner from the selected participants.

ruleGuide.dartsCork.play.defaultMessage: The cork winner, determined by the dart closest to the center before play, starts. One player per side throws one dart; any bull or outer bull is removed before the next throw. Cork throws do not count toward scores.

ruleGuide.dartsCork.tie.defaultMessage: For a tie, two bulls or two outer bulls, the sides tied for the start throw again in reverse order. The cork determines only the initial start; later legs follow the displayed setting. With more than two sides or in Cricket, this is the agreed starting procedure for this game.

pwaUpdate.help.defaultMessage: The PWA checks its hosting site for new versions. Installing reloads the app and keeps your saved data.

pwaUpdate.notice.defaultMessage: Save your input before opening Settings to install it. The app never reloads automatically.

pwaUpdate.ready.defaultMessage: The new version is downloaded and ready to install.

pwaUpdate.current.defaultMessage: Your app is up to date on this site.

pwaUpdate.beforeApply.defaultMessage: Pause or finish your games, then close other Scoretrackrr tabs and windows. Save any unfinished input before leaving its page.

pwaUpdate.unsupported.defaultMessage: Updates are available in the production version, in a browser that supports PWAs.

pwaUpdate.errors.offline.defaultMessage: Reconnect to check for updates. A version already downloaded can be installed offline.

pwaUpdate.errors.checkFailed.defaultMessage: The update could not be checked or downloaded. Your current version remains available; try again later.

pwaUpdate.errors.otherTabs.defaultMessage: Close other Scoretrackrr tabs and windows, then try again.

pwaUpdate.errors.activationFailed.defaultMessage: The update could not be applied. Try again, or close all app windows before reopening it.

pwaUpdate.errors.gameRunning.defaultMessage: A game is running. Pause or finish it before installing the update.

pwaUpdate.errors.storage.defaultMessage: Local storage is unavailable. Updating is blocked to protect your games.

matches.controlsError.defaultMessage: The game controls could not be loaded. Your saved scores are preserved. Try again.

parameters.x01StartHint.defaultMessage: Choose the starting score, from 101 to 701 points.

play.orderHint.defaultMessage: This order defines turns. Cork and starting rules take priority.

play.presetHint.defaultMessage: Save settings and participants on this device. Edit a setup before creating the match. Cork must be played again.

play.presetApplied.defaultMessage: Setup applied. Check participants and the starter.

play.presetUnavailable.defaultMessage: Setup unavailable: a player, team or settings have changed.

play.storageError.defaultMessage: Unable to save locally. Your match remains available.

play.draftRecovered.defaultMessage: Input recovered · review before saving. No points added.

play.previewIncomplete.defaultMessage: Complete a valid entry to preview the result.

play.bust.defaultMessage: Bust · this visit does not count

play.wakeUnsupported.defaultMessage: Keeping the screen awake is unavailable.

play.wakeRefused.defaultMessage: The system declined to keep the screen awake.

play.wakeReleased.defaultMessage: The system released the screen lock.

play.entryClosed.defaultMessage: Entry is closed. Scores remain available above.

skull.needTrick.defaultMessage: Win at least one trick before adding captures.

skull.inventoryHint.defaultMessage: Limits include tricks and captures already assigned, including unsubmitted entries.

sixNimmt.surprisesSetup.defaultMessage: 2–8 players · 12 number cards · 3 action cards · 2 rounds

sixNimmt.passCards.defaultMessage: Pass one card to the left

sixNimmt.surprisesHint.defaultMessage: Enter the bullheads left in each player’s pile after applying action cards, including Minus = Plus. A round cannot score below zero. The match ends after round 2.

skull.expansionHint.defaultMessage: 19 cards, including First Mate Con, Davy Jones’ Locker and the Spotted Stingray

skull.lootHint.defaultMessage: Count only successful Loot partnerships: both players must meet their bids exactly. Each receives 20 points per partnership, including with Rascal scoring.

skull.rascalHint.defaultMessage: 10 points per card dealt for an exact bid; half for a bid off by one; zero otherwise. Capture bonuses follow the same multiplier.

skull.discardedHint.defaultMessage: {count} tricks unassigned. With sea creatures, discarded tricks have no winner; leave them unassigned.

ruleGuide.six.surprisesDeal.defaultMessage: Deal 12 number cards and 3 action cards to each of 2–8 players. Begin four rows. Action cards are played on the physical table.

ruleGuide.six.jokers.defaultMessage: Deal one Joker per player in addition to the usual 10 cards. Each Joker is worth one bullhead; unused Jokers return to the box. A Joker can go on any row, never directly after another Joker.

ruleGuide.six.passCards.defaultMessage: Before revealing cards, each player passes one card face down to their left-hand neighbor. Skip the exchange on the last turn.

ruleGuide.six.variableRows.defaultMessage: The first card with several bullheads sets the row’s length: 2, 3, 5 or 7 bullheads allow 1, 2, 4 or 6 more cards before the next player takes the row.

ruleGuide.six.surprisesRecord.defaultMessage: Record each player’s remaining penalty pile after action-card effects. Minus = Plus removes penalties within the current round; excess cancellation is lost. Start a fresh pile next round.

ruleGuide.six.surprisesFinish.defaultMessage: Play exactly two rounds. Add both penalties; the lowest total wins, with shared victories on ties.

ruleGuide.skull.rascal.defaultMessage: Rascal: exact bid earns 10 × cards dealt; off by one earns half; further away earns zero. Apply the same multiplier to capture bonuses. Loot still requires exact bids.

ruleGuide.skull.advanced.defaultMessage: Kraken discards its trick. White Whale removes special cards: the highest number wins. If no winning card remains, discard the trick. Record only tricks actually won.

ruleGuide.skull.expansion.defaultMessage: Expansion captures: each 7 is −5; each 8 is +5; First Mate is +30 when captured by the King or a Mermaid. Davy earns +20 per captured sea creature, even without winning the trick. The 0/14 cards have no capture bonus.

ruleGuide.skull.loot.defaultMessage: Each of the two Loot cards can reward both partners with 20 points only when both meet their bids exactly. Enter successful partnerships for each partner.

matchOptions.sixExpansion.defaultMessage: {kind, select, none {Classic} jokers {Vachement bien! · Jokers} other {6 qui surprend!}}

skull.noTrickHint.defaultMessage: Only bonuses allowed without winning a trick remain available.

scoreSheet.last.defaultMessage: Finish the match with this entry

scoreSheet.bonuses.defaultMessage: Net bonus for the taker side

scoreSheet.blocked.defaultMessage: Blocked game, no player went out

scoreSheet.drawColor.defaultMessage: Number of Wild Draw Color cards (60 points)

scoreSheet.manualEnd.defaultMessage: Mark the last entry when the table agrees the match is over.

scoreSheet.finalEnd.defaultMessage: Save one complete scoring sheet to determine the result.

scoreSheet.beloteRoster.defaultMessage: Select two teams of two players.

games.descriptions.skyjo.defaultMessage: Enter the value of each player’s remaining grid and identify who closed.

scoreSheet.skyjo.hint.defaultMessage: Enter the value of each player’s remaining grid and identify who closed. A positive score doubles if that player fails to score strictly lower than everyone else.

games.descriptions.belote.defaultMessage: Enter each team’s awarded points after applying your classic Belote or Coinche contracts, bonuses and rounding rules..

scoreSheet.belote.hint.defaultMessage: Enter each team’s awarded points after applying your classic Belote or Coinche contracts, bonuses and rounding rules.

games.descriptions.tarot.defaultMessage: Enter the contract, oudlers and the taker side’s card points.

scoreSheet.tarot.hint.defaultMessage: Enter the contract, oudlers and the taker side’s card points. Enter the net bonuses for the taker side, including any signed Petit au bout and applicable hand or slam bonuses.

games.descriptions.rummy.defaultMessage: Choose the player who went out and enter the value of each opponent’s remaining hand.

scoreSheet.rummy.hint.defaultMessage: Choose the player who went out and enter the value of each opponent’s remaining hand. Those points go to the winner.

games.descriptions.uno.defaultMessage: Choose the player who went out.

scoreSheet.uno.hint.defaultMessage: Choose the player who went out. Count the other players’ remaining cards, using the visible side for UNO Flip. Number cards keep their face value.

games.descriptions.scrabble.defaultMessage: Enter each turn’s score after applying board premiums.

scoreSheet.scrabble.hint.defaultMessage: Enter each turn’s score after applying board premiums. At the end, enter remaining tile values to subtract them and credit the player who went out, if any.

games.descriptions.seven-wonders.defaultMessage: Enter each player’s points in the seven categories.

scoreSheet.seven-wonders.hint.defaultMessage: Enter each player’s points by category. Coins and science symbols are converted into points automatically.

games.descriptions.qwixx.defaultMessage: Enter each player’s marked boxes by color, including row locks, and their missed moves.

scoreSheet.qwixx.hint.defaultMessage: Enter each player’s marked boxes by color, including row locks, and their missed moves. Each missed move costs five points.

games.descriptions.clever.defaultMessage: Enter scores for the five colored zones and count the foxes.

scoreSheet.clever.hint.defaultMessage: Enter scores for the five colored zones and count the foxes. Each fox scores the value of the lowest zone.

games.descriptions.dominoes.defaultMessage: For draw or block play, select the hand winner and enter the pips left with each opponent.

scoreSheet.dominoes.hint.defaultMessage: For draw or block play, select the hand winner and enter the pips left with each opponent. The winner scores their sum.

scoreSheet.skyjo.scoring.defaultMessage: A grid worth 12 doubles to 24 if the closer ties another player on 12. Zero and negative scores stay unchanged.

scoreSheet.belote.scoring.defaultMessage: The app adds the points entered for each team. Apply the last-trick bonus, announcements, contract and any carryover before saving.

scoreSheet.tarot.scoring.defaultMessage: The contract multiplier applies to 25 plus the absolute margin. The total is signed according to success or failure, then the signed bonuses are added.

scoreSheet.rummy.scoring.defaultMessage: In basic Rummy, face cards are worth 10, aces 1 and number cards their face value.

scoreSheet.uno.scoring.defaultMessage: Count 20 for ordinary actions and 50 for wilds. In UNO Flip, count 60 for Wild Draw Color.

scoreSheet.scrabble.scoring.defaultMessage: In a blocked game, everyone loses the value of their remaining tiles. If a player goes out, add the other players’ deductions to that player’s score.

scoreSheet.seven-wonders.scoring.defaultMessage: Each set of three distinct science symbols adds 7 points. Each symbol type also scores the square of its count. Every 3 coins add 1 point.

scoreSheet.qwixx.scoring.defaultMessage: For example, four marks in a row score 10 points. Two missed moves cost 10 points.

scoreSheet.clever.scoring.defaultMessage: A zone with zero points makes every fox worth zero.

scoreSheet.dominoes.scoring.defaultMessage: This sheet uses the sum of the opponents’ remaining pips. Agree on this scoring convention before starting.

pwaInstall.fallback.defaultMessage: To install Scoretrackrr, use your browser menu.
